mapper.select: SELECT LMS_PRF_ID FROM LMS_PROFILE WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}

SELECT l.LEC_ID AS lecId, s.SEM_ID AS semId, s.SEM_YEAR AS semYear, s.SEM_TERM AS semTerm, CASE WHEN TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN TRUNC(s.SEM_STR_DATE) AND TRUNC(s.SEM_END_DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS inProgressFlag, lc.LEC_COD_NAME AS courseName, l.LEC_SECTION AS lecSection, l.LEC_VAL_STATUS AS lecValStatus, (SELECT LISTAGG( CASE t.LEC_TIM_DAY_CODE WHEN 'MON' THEN '월' WHEN 'TUE' THEN '화' WHEN 'WED' THEN '수' WHEN 'THU' THEN '목' WHEN 'FRI' THEN '금' WHEN 'SAT' THEN '토' WHEN 'SUN' THEN '일' ELSE '?' END || ' ' || TO_CHAR(t.LEC_TIM_STR_TIME, 'HH24:MI'), ' · ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY CASE t.LEC_TIM_DAY_CODE WHEN 'MON' THEN 1 WHEN 'TUE' THEN 2 WHEN 'WED' THEN 3 WHEN 'THU' THEN 4 WHEN 'FRI' THEN 5 WHEN 'SAT' THEN 6 WHEN 'SUN' THEN 7 ELSE 8 END, t.LEC_TIM_STR_TIME) FROM LECTURE_TIME t WHERE t.LEC_ID = l.LEC_ID) AS schedule, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LECTURE_STUDENT_ENROLLMENT e WHERE e.LEC_ID = l.LEC_ID AND e.LEC_STD_ENR_STATUS != 'DRP') AS studentCount, (SELECT ROUND(AVG(stu.attRate), 0) FROM ( SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM STUDENT_ENROLLMENT_ATTENDANCE a WHERE a.LEC_STD_ENR_ID = e2.LEC_STD_ENR_ID AND a.STD_ENR_ATD_STS_CODE = 'PRS') * 100.0 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM STUDENT_ENROLLMENT_ATTENDANCE a WHERE a.LEC_STD_ENR_ID = e2.LEC_STD_ENR_ID), 0) AS attRate FROM LECTURE_STUDENT_ENROLLMENT e2 WHERE e2.LEC_ID = l.LEC_ID AND e2.LEC_STD_ENR_STATUS != 'DRP' ) stu) AS attendanceRate, (SELECT NVL(SUM(GREATEST(pa.totalStudents - pa.gradedCount, 0)), 0) FROM ( SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LECTURE_STUDENT_ENROLLMENT e3 WHERE e3.LEC_ID = asn.LEC_ID AND e3.LEC_STD_ENR_STATUS != 'DRP') AS totalStudents, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LECTURE_ASSIGNMENT_SUBMISSION sb JOIN ASSIGNMENT_SUBMISSION_EVALUATION ev ON ev.LEC_ASN_SBM_ID = sb.LEC_ASN_SBM_ID WHERE sb.LEC_ASN_ID = asn.LEC_ASN_ID AND ev.ASN_SBM_EVL_SCORE IS NOT NULL) AS gradedCount FROM LECTURE_ASSIGNMENT asn WHERE asn.LEC_ID = l.LEC_ID ) pa) AS ungradedCount FROM LECTURE l JOIN LECTURE_CODE lc ON lc.LEC_CODE_ID = l.LEC_CODE_ID JOIN SEMESTERS s ON s.SEM_ID = l.SEM_ID WHERE l.LMS_PRF_ID = #{lmsPrfId}
AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) >= TRUNC(s.SEM_STR_DATE) ORDER BY inProgressFlag DESC, s.SEM_STR_DATE DESC, l.LEC_ID
